### Bottom line

Based on the information that is publicly available in the 2020 Accountability Plans, **the University of Central Florida is the only Florida State University System member that failed to meet its approved median‑wage goal in at least three of the four years 2014‑15 through 2017‑18**. If and when the full median‑wage tables for other universities are made available, the list could grow, but with the data at hand only UCF qualifies.
